summary: Estate road end by a bush-backed turning circle; townhouses 10-20 m off.
reasons: Bush backs the end turning circle
Vehicle already parked at the turning circle

best_section.where: At the end of the estate road, by the bush-edged turning circle

drivers.seclusion: Bush and the highway embankment east; the nearest townhouse is about 10-20 m back along the lane. Homes are unmapped in OSM.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane runs into a wider turning circle with a vehicle parked in it; enough room for a van to pull off the through line.
drivers.traffic: Residents-only dead end; the highway is beyond bush to the east.
drivers.convention: Looks like part of a private townhouse estate; a vehicle is parked at the end.

flags: Looks like a private estate road
Homes not mapped in OSM but clear in imagery
sun_shade: Bush shades the east and south sides in the morning; open to afternoon sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the estate road is private
